mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN pf.authorize_workspace_actor(#{actor.userId},#{actor.spaceId}) THEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.space WHERE id=#{actor.spaceId} AND owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} AND type='PERSONAL') ELSE false END
SELECT 1 FROM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('r62:version:'||CAST(#{actor.spaceId} AS text)||':'||CAST(#{actor.userId} AS text),0))

SELECT s.capability_id,s.version_id,s.state,s.revision,p.name,p.description,p.manifest::text,p.dependency_manifest::text, (a.status='AVAILABLE') AS asset_available FROM pf.capability_version_status s JOIN pf.capability c ON c.space_id=s.space_id AND c.owner_user_id=s.owner_user_id AND c.id=s.capability_id AND c.kind='SKILL' JOIN pf.skill_package_version p ON p.space_id=s.space_id AND p.owner_user_id=s.owner_user_id AND p.capability_id=s.capability_id AND p.version_id=s.version_id JOIN pf.asset_object a ON a.space_id=p.space_id AND a.id=p.asset_id WHERE s.space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND s.owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} AND s.capability_id=#{capability} AND s.version_id=#{version} FOR UPDATE OF s

SELECT p.capability_id,p.version_id,a.object_key,p.archive_bytes,p.archive_sha256,p.manifest::text FROM pf.skill_package_version p JOIN pf.capability_version_status s ON s.space_id=p.space_id AND s.owner_user_id=p.owner_user_id AND s.capability_id=p.capability_id AND s.version_id=p.version_id AND s.state='PUBLISHED' JOIN pf.capability c ON c.space_id=p.space_id AND c.owner_user_id=p.owner_user_id AND c.id=p.capability_id AND c.kind='SKILL' JOIN pf.asset_object a ON a.space_id=p.space_id AND a.id=p.asset_id AND a.status='AVAILABLE' WHERE p.space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND p.owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} AND p.capability_id=#{capability} AND p.version_id=#{version}

SELECT request_id,capability_id,version_id,action,expected_revision,result_revision,result_state FROM pf.capability_version_command WHERE space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} AND request_id=#{request}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pf.capability_audit(id,space_id,owner_user_id,action,resource_id,trace_id) VALUES(#{id},#{actor.spaceId},#{actor.userId},CASE WHEN #{command.action}='PUBLISH' THEN 'SKILL_PUBLISHED' ELSE 'SKILL_REVOKED' END,#{command.versionId},#{trace})
